name: Tourio360
summary:
Tourio 360 VR brings Tourio 360 virtual tours into Meta Quest. It opens straight into virtual reality and shows the public tours in a library in front of you.

• Walk through spaces: point at the floor and tap to move to the next room. In many rooms the cursor recognises the floor, walls and ceiling. • Turn the view without standing up: grab the picture and drag, or use the thumbstick to turn 30° at a time. • Guided visits: enter the code your guide gave you. The guide sees what you see and can talk to you.
